lines.japanese: 「二年参り？」
lines.english: “A midnight shrine visit?”

lines.japanese: 「大晦日だからな」
lines.english: “It’s New Year’s Eve.”

lines.japanese: 「でも今からって…まだ７時前だぞ？」
lines.english: “But now? It's not even seven yet.”

lines.japanese:
武也からの呼び出しがかかったのは、
夕食代わりの蕎麦をちょうど鍋の中に
放り込もうとした直前だった。
lines.english: Takeya’s summons came just as I was about to drop a bundle of soba into the pot and call it dinner.

lines.japanese:
「実は３部制になっててだな…今から第１部の忘年会。
除夜の鐘が鳴り出したら第２部の二年参り。
それが終わったら第３部のオールナイト新年会」
lines.english: “Actually, tonight's a three-part event. First comes the year-end party. When the temple bells start, we move on to the midnight shrine visit. Then we finish with an all-night New Year's party.”

lines.japanese: 「…元気だなお前」
lines.english: “…Where do you get the energy?”

lines.japanese:
「いやいやこれでもさっきまで落ち込んでたんだぜ？
せっかくの大晦日なのに、付き合ってくれる女の子が
誰も捕まらなくてさ」
lines.english: “Hey, I was depressed until a minute ago. New Year's Eve, and I couldn't find a single girl to spend it with.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど、それで仕方なく俺って訳か」
lines.english: “So in desperation, you settled for me.”

lines.japanese:
「二人は田舎に帰省しちまってて、
一人はクリスマスにすっぽかしたせいで別れちまって、
あとの一人はＯＫだったんだけどあの日だって…」
lines.english: “Two went home for the holidays. One dumped me because I stood her up at Christmas. The last one said yes, but she's on her period…”

lines.japanese: 「いやその最後のコと行って来いよ！」
lines.english: “Then go with her!”

lines.japanese:
「だってさぁ、振り袖着てくるとか言ってんだぜ？
それで何もできないとか余計悔しいじゃん？」
lines.english: “But she says she's wearing a formal kimono. If she shows up looking like that and I can't even make a move, that's torture.”

lines.japanese:
「そんな即物的な理由で断られた彼女の方が
よほど悔しいと思うぞ」
lines.english: “I imagine she's even more frustrated, being turned down for something that shallow.”

lines.japanese:
「ま、そんなことはいいから今から出てこいよ。
今年も色々あったけど、パァ～っと水に流そうぜ？」
lines.english: “Never mind. Just get over here. It's been quite a year—let's have one big night and wipe the slate clean.”

lines.japanese: 「誰が来るんだ？」
lines.english: “Who’s coming?”

lines.japanese:
「そりゃまぁ、いつものメンバーだよ。
依緒と、俺と…」
lines.english: “The usual crowd. Io, me, and…”

lines.japanese: 「…そんだけ」
lines.english: “…That’s it.”

lines.japanese: 「…そっか」
lines.english: “…Right.”

lines.japanese:
ある意味、予想通りな面子。
…出席者も欠席者も。
lines.english: In one sense, it was exactly the lineup I'd expected—the ones coming and the one who wasn't.

lines.japanese:
今の雪菜が、俺と鉢合わせする可能性のあるところに、
そんなに簡単に顔を出すはずがないってわかってた。
lines.english: I knew Setsuna as she was now wouldn’t just turn up somewhere she might run into me.

lines.japanese:
だからこそ、ある意味ほっとして、
そしてある意味落胆してる俺がいる。
lines.english: That knowledge left one part of me relieved and another disappointed.

lines.japanese: 「駄目か？」
lines.english: “Can’t make it?”

lines.japanese: 用事は…ないわけでもない。
lines.english: I did have somewhere else I could be.

lines.japanese:
昨日、郵便で届いた一枚の紙切れが、
テーブルの上に無造作に置かれている。
lines.english: A single slip of paper had arrived in yesterday's mail. I'd left it carelessly on the table.

lines.japanese:
麻理さんから送られてきた、
冬馬曜子のニューイヤーコンサートチケット。
lines.english: The ticket Mari had sent me for Youko Touma's New Year's concert.

lines.japanese:
開演は八時。
今から出れば、まだ十分間に合う。
lines.english: It started at eight. If I left now, I could still make it with time to spare.

lines.japanese:
けれど、つまりそれって、
武也の誘いと思いっきりバッティングしてるってこと。
lines.english: Which meant it collided head-on with Takeya's invitation.

lines.japanese:
「………なぁ、春希。
今のお前、本当に大丈夫なのか？」
lines.english: “Haruki… are you sure you’re all right?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ、それ」
lines.english: “What’s that supposed to mean?”

lines.japanese: 興味がないと言えば嘘になる。
lines.english: I'd be lying if I said the concert held no appeal.

lines.japanese:
世界的なピアニストの生演奏。プレミア席。
しかも、俺の初仕事が認められての特別招待。
lines.english: A world-famous pianist, live. A premium seat. And a special invitation, all because my first assignment had been a success.

lines.japanese:
『せっかくだから楽屋に顔出してみたらどうだ？
きっとアンサンブルの名前を出せば会ってくれるぞ？』
lines.english: ‘Why don't you stop by backstage while you're there? Mention Ensemble and I'm sure she'll see you.’

lines.japanese:
…けれど、冬馬曜子本人と、
その演奏を目の当たりにすれば、
きっと嫌でも思い出してしまう。
lines.english: But if I saw Youko Touma in person—if I watched her play—I would remember whether I wanted to or not.

lines.japanese:
彼女の血と才能を受け継ぎ、
きっと海の向こうで同じように舞台に立って、
同じように観客の視線を一手に集めている…
lines.english: The girl who had inherited her blood and her gift. The girl who must be standing on stages across the sea just as her mother did, holding every eye in the hall…

lines.japanese:
『もしかしたら…
冬馬かずさと会わせてくれるかもしれないだろ？』
lines.english: ‘She might even arrange for you to see Kazusa Touma.’

lines.japanese: いや、これから集めるであろう“あいつ”のことを。
lines.english: No—not yet. The girl who would hold all those eyes someday.

lines.japanese:
「あのさ…もしかして、俺たちのしたことって
逆効果だったのか？」
lines.english: “Listen… did we only make things worse?”

lines.japanese: 「別に…」
lines.english: “Not really…”

lines.japanese: 「別に…どっちだよ？」
lines.english: “Not really what?”

lines.japanese: もしかしたら、冬馬曜子は俺のこと覚えてるだろうか？
lines.english: Would Youko Touma remember me?

lines.japanese:
もし忘れてても、あの記事を書いた記者だと言って、
控え室に押しかければ会ってくれるかもしれない。
lines.english: Even if she had forgotten, I might get to see her by barging into her dressing room and introducing myself as the reporter who wrote that article.

lines.japanese: そして、俺の顔を見たら思い出してくれるかもしれない。
lines.english: Then one look at my face might bring everything back.

lines.japanese: そしたら彼女は、娘に俺のことを伝えるだろうか？
lines.english: Would she tell her daughter about me?

lines.japanese: 『会いたいんじゃないのか？　本当は』
lines.english: ‘Isn't that what you really want?’

lines.japanese:
俺とかずさの接点が、もう一度…
もう一度、かずさに会える道筋ができるかもしれない…
lines.english: There might be a connection between Kazusa and me again. Once more, a path might open that led me back to her…

lines.japanese:
「なぁ、春希。
２４日の夜、お前たち一体…」
lines.english: “Haruki, on the night of the twenty-fourth, what exactly did you two—”

lines.japanese: 「武也」
lines.english: “Takeya.”
“Yeah?”

lines.japanese: だったら、俺は…
lines.english: And if there were, I would…

lines.japanese: １．コンサートに行く
lines.english: 1. Go to the concert

lines.japanese: ２．二年参りに行く
lines.english: 2. Go on the midnight shrine visit

lines.japanese: 「で、どこだ？」
lines.english: “So where?”

lines.japanese: 「え、何が？」
lines.english: “Huh? Where?”

lines.japanese:
「何って…待ち合わせ場所だよ。
お前、なんのために俺に電話してきたんだ？」
lines.english: “Where are we meeting? Why else did you call?”

lines.japanese: もうやめよう。
lines.english: Enough.

lines.japanese:
雪菜との決着をつけないまま、
“冬馬”という姓を引きずるのは。
lines.english: I had to stop clinging to the name Touma while everything with Setsuna remained unresolved.

lines.japanese: 「え？　あ、あ………いいの、か？」
lines.english: “Wait. You mean it? You'll come?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、駄目な方向で」
lines.english: “I can always decide not to.”

lines.japanese:
「待て！　御宿の東口改札！
今から３０分後！」
lines.english: “Wait! East ticket gate, Onjuku Station! Thirty minutes!”

lines.japanese:
「最初からそう言やいいんだよ。
余計な気、使いやがって」
lines.english: “You could've led with that. Quit worrying so much about me.”

lines.japanese: 「悪い…」
lines.english: “Sorry…”

lines.japanese:
きっとあいつらは、俺を囲んで
『あの日』の真実を聞き出そうとするだろう。
lines.english: They would probably surround me and demand the truth about that day.

lines.japanese:
けれど今の俺には、
自分の罪を隠す気も、逃げる気もない。
lines.english: But now I had no intention of hiding what I'd done or running from it.

lines.japanese:
正面からあいつらに向き合い、罵倒され…
そして、審判を受けよう。
lines.english: I would face them. Let them curse me. Submit to their judgment.

lines.japanese: 「何それ…」
lines.english: “What the hell is that supposed to mean?”
“…I’m sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「い、依緒…落ち着けって」
lines.english: “I-Io, calm down.”

lines.japanese:
つい数分前、乾杯の音頭とともに掲げられたジョッキが、
怒りの鉄拳のごとくテーブルに叩きつけられた。
lines.english: The mug Io had raised for our toast only minutes ago slammed onto the table like an iron fist.

lines.japanese: けれど…
lines.english: But…

lines.japanese:
「なんで…
なんで今さらそんなこと言うんだよ雪菜は！」
lines.english: “Why? Why would Setsuna wait until now to say something like that?”
“What?”

lines.japanese:
「だから大きな声出すなって！
春希だって十分傷つい………雪菜ちゃん？」
lines.english: “Keep your voice down! Haruki's been hurt enough alrea—Setsuna?”

lines.japanese:
その依緒の怒りは予想通りだったのに、
依緒が怒りを向けた相手は、予想もしていなかった。
lines.english: Io's fury was exactly what I'd expected. I had not expected where she aimed it.

lines.japanese:
「わかってたじゃんか…
わかってたじゃんか春希が冬馬のこと忘れてないなんて。
ずっと引きずってるなんて、一番わかってたじゃんか！」
lines.english: “She knew! She knew Haruki had never forgotten Touma. She knew better than anyone that he'd never gotten over her!”

lines.japanese: 「依緒…」
lines.english: “Io…”

lines.japanese:
「わかってて、それでも雪菜、春希のこと好きだって。
だから、あたしだって力になりたいって思ってたのに…」
lines.english: “She knew, and she still said she loved him. That's why I wanted to stand by her, but…”

lines.japanese:
「ああ、そうだな。
だから俺たちはずっと雪菜ちゃんの味方でいようって…」
lines.english: “Yeah. That’s why we promised we’d always be on Setsuna’s side…”

lines.japanese:
「なのに、春希が雪菜に向かい合おうとした途端、
そんなわかりきってたこと持ち出して
春希の手をはねのけるって、一体どういう了見だよ！」
lines.english: “But the moment Haruki finally faces her, she throws the one thing she's known all along in his face and knocks his hand away? What the hell is that?”

lines.japanese:
依緒の怒りの方向性が理解できない俺は、
ただ、その憤怒の表情をぽかんと見つめるだけだった。
lines.english: I couldn't understand why Io was angry with Setsuna. I could only stare at her furious face.

lines.japanese:
けれどそれは、当事者である俺だけでなく、
隣の武也にとっても共感のできない、
つまり、男にはわからないって感じの思考らしかった。
lines.english: And it wasn't only me. Takeya couldn't follow her either. Apparently this was one of those turns of thought men simply couldn't make.

lines.japanese:
「どんだけひねくれてるんだよ。
どんだけめんどくさいんだよ、あいつ…」
lines.english: “How twisted can one person be? How impossibly difficult can she make this?”

lines.japanese:
「それは…だから俺が。
雪菜がそうなったのも俺の…」
lines.english: “That's because of me. If Setsuna became like this, it's my—”

lines.japanese:
「あたしには、タチの悪い復讐にしか思えないよ！
無意味な意趣返しにしか感じられないよ！」
lines.english: “It looks like vicious revenge to me! Pointless retaliation!”

lines.japanese:
「そんなわけないだろ…
口説き文句じゃなく天使だって言えるコなんて、
俺の知ってる中で彼女以外にいないぜ？」
lines.english: “No chance. She's the only girl I've ever called an angel without using it as a pickup line.”

lines.japanese:
「だとしても、今回雪菜のしたことは汚いよ。
天使は天使でも堕天使の所業だよ」
lines.english: “Then what she did this time was dirty. Angel or not, that was the work of a fallen one.”

lines.japanese:
「地上に引きずり下ろされたんだよ。
悪い男に引っかかって」
lines.english: “A bad man dragged her down to earth. A bad man named Haruki.”
lines.japaneseRuby:
「地上に引きずり下ろされたんだよ。
[R悪い男^はるき]に引っかかって」

lines.japanese:
全面的に俺を庇う依緒よりも、
徹底的に俺を貶める武也の言葉の方が、
俺にはよほど理解できた。
lines.english: Takeya's determination to grind me into the dirt made far more sense than Io's wholehearted defense.

lines.japanese:
「なんでそんな雪菜を庇うの？
今回に限っては、絶対に雪菜に非があるって。
あのコが春希にどれだけ酷いことしたのかわかる？」
lines.english: “Why are you still defending her? This time Setsuna was absolutely in the wrong. Do you have any idea what she did to Haruki?”

lines.japanese:
だって、まさか俺が庇われるとは夢にも思わない。
それも、真っ先に手を上げてきそうな奴に。
lines.english: It had never occurred to me that anyone might defend me—least of all the person I'd expected to throw the first punch.

lines.japanese:
「だから仕方ないんだって。
ずっと…ずっと心の中に溜め込んでたんだ。
言えなかったんだよ、雪菜ちゃん優しすぎるから」
lines.english: “She couldn't help it. She'd been holding all of that inside for years. She couldn't say it because she's too kind.”

lines.japanese:
「ギリギリになって大爆発するくらいなら
最初から弾けろよ！
責めろよ！　春希の非を認めてやれよ！」
lines.english: “If she was going to explode at the last possible second, she should've exploded at the start! Blamed him! Admitted he was the one at fault!”

lines.japanese: 「依緒…」
lines.english: “Io…”

lines.japanese:
俺が女の気持ちに鈍感なのはわかってたけど、
でも、武也までついていけてないってのは…
lines.english: I knew I was hopeless at understanding women. But if even Takeya had lost the thread…

lines.japanese:
依緒のメンタリティが特殊なのか、
実は俺たちのどっちも、
女の気持ちなんてさっぱりわかっていないのか…
lines.english: Either Io's mind was a category all its own, or neither of us understood women in the slightest.

lines.japanese:
それとも…
どっちも正解なのか。
lines.english: Or both.

lines.japanese:
「雪菜ってさ…今までずっと譲らなかったじゃん。
春希は悪くないって、絶対に悪くないって」
lines.english: “Setsuna never gave an inch, remember? Haruki wasn't at fault. He absolutely wasn't at fault.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ…そうだけどさ」
lines.english: “Well… yeah.”

lines.japanese:
「けどさぁ…あの時のことは、
どう考えたって春希が悪かったんだよ。
こいつが雪菜に酷いことをしたのは間違いないんだよ」
lines.english: “But no matter how you look at what happened, Haruki was wrong. There's no question he did something terrible to her.”

lines.japanese: 「…ああ」
lines.english: “…Yeah.”

lines.japanese:
三年前の裏切り。
二年間の逃避。
そして一週間前の嘘。
lines.english: The betrayal three years ago. The two years I spent running. The lie one week ago.

lines.japanese:
依緒に言われるまでもなく、
武也に同意されるまでもなく、
俺の罪は、俺が一番よく知ってる。
lines.english: Io didn't need to tell me. Takeya didn't need to agree. No one knew my guilt better than I did.

lines.japanese:
知らなかったのは、
知ろうとしてくれなかったのは、
俺たちの中で、ただ一人だけ…
lines.english: Only one of us hadn't known—hadn't even tried to know.

lines.japanese:
「雪菜は一刻も早く、
春希が悪いって認めるべきだったんだ。
雪菜に責められることこそが、春希のためだったんだ」
lines.english: “Setsuna should've admitted from the beginning that Haruki was guilty. Being blamed by her was exactly what he needed.”

lines.japanese:
「だから雪菜ちゃん認めたじゃん。
…ちょっと時間がかかったけどさ」
lines.english: “But she did admit it. It just took her a while.”

lines.japanese:
「かかりすぎなんだよ…
そうやって雪菜がモタモタしてる間、
春希はずっと、冬馬のこと忘れられなかったんだから」
lines.english: “It took far too long. While Setsuna kept stalling, Haruki went on all those years unable to forget Touma.”

lines.japanese: 痛い…
lines.english: That hurt.

lines.japanese: こいつらの喋ってる内容は、痛すぎる。
lines.english: Every word out of their mouths hurt.

lines.japanese:
「雪菜が引きずるから。
引きずったまま、引きずってないふりなんかするから！」
lines.english: “Because Setsuna kept dragging it with her! Because she dragged it all those years and pretended she hadn't!”

lines.japanese:
真実を突いているからとか、
俺の過去をほじくり返してるからとか、
そういうことじゃなく…
lines.english: But not because they had struck the truth. Not because they were digging up my past.

lines.japanese:
ただ純粋に、喋ってる単語とか言い回しとかが、
あまりにも本気に満ち溢れてて、いたたまれなくなる。
lines.english: It was the words themselves, the way they said them—everything overflowing with such absolute conviction that I wanted to disappear.

lines.japanese: 今の、雪菜に対して本気になれなくなってしまった俺には。
lines.english: Because I could no longer give Setsuna my whole heart.
“…I’m leaving.”

lines.japanese: 「二年参りはどうすんだよ？」
lines.english: “What about the shrine?”

lines.japanese:
未だ憤懣やるかたない様子の依緒は、
もう付き合っていられないとばかりに立ち上がると、
さっさとコートを羽織った。
lines.english: Still burning with anger, Io stood as if she could bear our company no longer and yanked on her coat.
lines.japaneseRuby:
未だ[R憤懣^ふんまん]やるかたない様子の依緒は、
もう付き合っていられないとばかりに立ち上がると、
さっさとコートを羽織った。

lines.japanese:
「今から雪菜の家に行ってくる。
事と場合によっては絶交するかも」
lines.english: “I'm going to Setsuna's. Depending on what she says, I may never speak to her again.”
“What—”

lines.japanese:
「だからやめとけってそういうこと言うの。
春希だって全然そんなの望んでないし」
lines.english: “Don't say that. Haruki doesn't want anything like that either.”

lines.japanese: 「今度は…今度だけは、絶対に雪菜が悪いよ」
lines.english: “This time—just this once—Setsuna is absolutely wrong.”

lines.japanese:
「だけどさぁ、
今一番苦しんでるのだって、やっぱ雪菜ちゃんだろ」
lines.english: “But Setsuna's still the one hurting most right now.”

lines.japanese:
「春希のこと振っておいて？
今まで散々思わせぶりな態度取ってたくせに？」
lines.english: “After dumping Haruki? After leading him on all this time?”

lines.japanese:
「だってさ…
振られるより、振る方が辛いじゃん」
lines.english: “Leaving someone hurts more than being left.”

lines.japanese:
「お～お～。
どっちも沢山経験してる人の言うことは重みがあるねぇ」
lines.english: “Oh, listen to the expert. A man with all that experience on both sides must know.”

lines.japanese: 「…お前にはわかんないか？」
lines.english: “…You don’t understand?”

lines.japanese:
「あ～全然わかんない。
だってあたし、人をふったことないし」
lines.english: “Not a bit. I’ve never rejected anyone.”

lines.japanese: 「………ボケんのも大概にしろよ？」
lines.english: “…You can quit playing dumb anytime now.”

lines.japanese: 「…なんだって？」
lines.english: “…What did you say?”

lines.japanese:
「だからやめろって！
ここでお前らが喧嘩したってしょうがないだろ！」
lines.english: “Enough! You two fighting each other won't solve anything!”

lines.japanese:
二人が俺を糾弾するはずの忘年会は、
いつの間にか一触即発な二人を俺が仲裁するという、
当初の主旨を完全に違えた場へと変貌していた。
lines.english: The year-end party at which they were supposed to put me on trial had become an armed standoff between the two of them, with me as mediator. We had somehow inverted the whole purpose of the night.

lines.japanese:
だって今、武也のこめかみ辺りから
『ぶちん』って音が、本当に聞こえてきた気がしたから。
lines.english: I could have sworn I heard something snap at Takeya's temple.

lines.japanese: 「そろそろ終わりだな、今年も」
lines.english: “Not much left of this year.”

lines.japanese: 携帯の時計を見ると、２３時５５分。
lines.english: My phone said 11:55.

lines.japanese: 除夜の鐘も、とっくに耳に届いてくる時間になっていた。
lines.english: By now the New Year's Eve bells had long since begun to carry through the streets.

lines.japanese: 「で、どうする？」
lines.english: “So what are we doing?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「どうするって…解散？」
lines.english: “What do you mean? Are we calling it a night?”

lines.japanese:
「…あのなぁ、
お前ら今日の主旨忘れたのか？」
lines.english: “Did both of you forget why we came out tonight?”

lines.japanese:
俺が武也から誘われたときには、
確かに『二年参り』という単語があったはずだった。
lines.english: When Takeya invited me, the phrase “midnight shrine visit” had definitely been part of the proposal.

lines.japanese:
…まぁ、その時の俺たちは、
こんなふうに喧嘩後じゃなかった訳だけど。
lines.english: Of course, when he invited me, the two of them had not just finished a fight.

lines.japanese: 「…ふぅ」
lines.english: “Whew…”

lines.japanese:
結局、あの後もギスギスした空気は続き、
誰もが無言のまま、ひらすら酒を口に運び。
lines.english: The hostility never lifted. For the rest of the party we drank in silence, one glass after another.

lines.japanese:
何故か、糾弾されたり励まされたりするはずだった俺が、
二人の機嫌を伺い、ただ一人注文係として
二人の間に挟まっていた。
lines.english: Somehow, instead of being condemned or encouraged, I spent the night wedged between them—watching their moods and placing every order myself.

lines.japanese:
…けどそれは、
俺が、そうやって人に気を使えるまでに、
元の自分を取り戻しかけてるって。
lines.english: But had either of them noticed what that meant? I had recovered enough of myself to worry about other people again.

lines.japanese:
女にふられた男らしさが抜けてきてるって、
気がついてるんだろうか、この二人。
lines.english: I was beginning to look a little less like a man fresh from a breakup.
“Oh…”

lines.japanese:
微妙に距離を置いて、
神社にも、駅にも行ける道を歩く二人に、
ただついて歩いていた俺は…
lines.english: They walked several paces apart down a road that could take us either to the shrine or to the station. I simply followed…

lines.japanese:
自分たちがいつの間にか
御宿芸術文化ホールの目の前に立ってるってことに、
今さらながら気づいた。
lines.english: Only then did I notice that we had somehow come to a stop outside the Onjuku Arts and Culture Hall.

lines.japanese:
ホールの階段から沢山の人たちが溢れ出てきて、
俺の目の前に、いきなり人の波が出来上がる。
lines.english: People spilled down the hall's steps, and all at once a human tide rose before me.

lines.japanese:
どうやらコンサートはたった今終わったらしい。
携帯の時計を見直すと、今の時刻は２３時５９分。
lines.english: The concert must have ended that very moment. I checked my phone again: 11:59.

lines.japanese:
…ニューイヤーコンサートというには、
ほんの少しだけ時間が足りなかったらしい。
lines.english: Their “New Year's concert” had fallen one minute short of the new year.

lines.japanese:
駅へと向かう人の波に飲み込まれ、
急に歩調がゆっくりになる。
lines.english: The crowd swept us toward the station, and our pace slowed to theirs.

lines.japanese:
ホールから出てきた人たちは皆、一様に顔を紅潮させ、
そのコンサートの凄さを口々に語っていた。
lines.english: Every face leaving the hall was flushed. Voices overlapped all around us, each trying to explain how extraordinary the concert had been.

lines.japanese:
除夜の鐘を掻き消すような興奮が俺の周囲に蔓延して、
ほんの少しだけ居心地の悪さを感じたけれど。
lines.english: Their excitement spread around me until it nearly drowned out the temple bells. I felt just slightly out of place.

lines.japanese:
それだけ素晴らしいコンサートだったんだろう。
…ほんの少しだけ、すっぽかしたことを後悔する。
lines.english: It must have been magnificent. I regretted not going—just a little.

lines.japanese: そんな浮ついた喧騒に身を委ねていると…
lines.english: I let the buoyant noise carry me with it…
“Oh…”

lines.japanese:
ちょうどその瞬間、
新しい年が訪れた。
lines.english: And at that exact moment, the new year arrived.

lines.japanese: 「あけましておめでとう、春希」
lines.english: “Happy New Year, Haruki.”

lines.japanese:
「新年おめでと～春希。
今年もよろしくな」
lines.english: “Happy New Year, Haruki. Let's make it a good one.”

lines.japanese:
「お前らなぁ…
ここには自分と俺以外にもう一人いることを認めろよ」
lines.english: “Would each of you please acknowledge that there's a third person standing here?”

lines.japanese:
そんな、休戦条件が揃っている条件下でも、
たった今勃発した冷戦は簡単には収まりそうになかった。
lines.english: Even with every condition for a truce now in place, the cold war that had just begun showed no sign of ending.

lines.japanese:
こいつら、何のために集まったんだよ。
…何のために、俺を呼び出したんだよ。
lines.english: What had these two gathered for? Why had they called me out here?

lines.japanese:
誰のせいで、喧嘩なんかしてるんだよ。
…どうすれば、元の空気に戻るんだよ。
lines.english: Whose fault was this fight? How was I supposed to get the old atmosphere back?

lines.japanese: ………本当に、本末転倒な奴ら。
lines.english: They really had gotten everything backward.

lines.japanese: 「なぁ、依緒」
lines.english: “Hey, Io.”
“…What?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと…頼みたいことがある」
lines.english: “There's something I need you to do.”

lines.japanese: 「お疲れさん」
lines.english: “Nice work tonight.”

lines.japanese:
「え？　なに？　感想？
…あたしにそういうこと聞く？」
lines.english: “What? You want my review? You're asking me?”

lines.japanese:
「わかってる。
悔しいけど、まだまだ勝てそうにない」
lines.english: “I know. It kills me to admit it, but I’m still nowhere near your level.”

lines.japanese:
「それじゃ、あたし先にホテルに帰るけど、
そっちは…え？」
lines.english: “I’ll head back to the hotel first. What about you—huh?”

lines.japanese: 「隣の席？」
lines.english: “The seat beside me?”

lines.japanese:
「そうよ。あんたの左側。
誰かいなかった？」
lines.english: “Yes, on your left. Was anyone there?”

lines.japanese: 「…そういえば、最初から最後まで空席だったな」
lines.english: “…Now that you mention it, it was empty from beginning to end.”
“…I see.”

lines.japanese: 「なに？　誰か知り合いでも呼んだの？」
lines.english: “Why? Did you invite someone you know?”

lines.japanese: 「まぁね…さすがに来てくれなかったか」
lines.english: “Something like that… I guess they didn’t come after all.”

lines.japanese:
「最初の旦那？　二番目の旦那？
それとも………あたしの父親？」
lines.english: “Your first husband? Your second? Or… my father?”

lines.japanese: 「…似たようなものかもね」
lines.english: “…Something like that, maybe.”

lines.japanese:
「よしてよ。
あたし今さらそんな相手に会っても、
どんな顔したらいいのかわかんないよ」
lines.english: “Don’t. If I met someone like that now, I wouldn’t know how to face them.”

lines.japanese:
「そっかぁぁ…ダメだったか…
そっかぁぁ…」
lines.english: “Oh… so it didn't work. I see…”

lines.japanese: 「…母さん？」
lines.english: “…Mom?”

lines.japanese:
「ねぇ、ホテル帰ったら飲まない？
…かずさ」
lines.english: “When we get back to the hotel… want to drink with me, Kazusa?”

lines.japanese: 「…なに言ってるの急に？」
lines.english: “…Where did that come from?”

lines.japanese:
「いいじゃん…あんたももうハタチ超えてるんだし。
娘と飲むの、夢だったのよね～」
lines.english: “Why not? You’re over twenty now. I always dreamed of drinking with my daughter.”

lines.japanese: 「…家でいつも飲んでるような気がするけど」
lines.english: “…We drink together at home all the time.”

lines.japanese:
「日本でってのが重要なのよ。
せっかく帰国してるんだから、
こう、お銚子で熱燗とかさぁ」
lines.english: “Doing it in Japan is what matters. We’re back home—we ought to have hot sake from one of those little flasks.”

lines.japanese:
「年寄り臭いなぁ…
ピアノはあんなに乱暴なくせに」
lines.english: “You sound like an old lady—hard to believe you play the piano like a brute.”

lines.japanese:
「もしかして用事でもある？
…誰か会いたい人でもいる？」
lines.english: “Do you have plans or something? Someone you want to see?”

lines.japanese: 「かずさ、あんたさ…」
lines.english: “Kazusa, you…”

lines.japanese: 「この国に、あたしの居場所はないんだよ、もう」
lines.english: “There's no place for me in this country anymore.”

lines.japanese:
「うん、わかった。
母さんの愚痴に付き合うのも久しぶりだし。
いいよ。朝まで飲もう？」
lines.english: “All right. It’s been a while since I sat through your complaints. Fine—let’s drink until morning.”

lines.japanese:
「何言ってんのよ～。大成功だったじゃない！
祝杯よ祝杯。よ～し、今日は寝かせないからね～」
lines.english: “Complain? The concert was a triumph! We’re celebrating. I’m not letting you sleep tonight!”

lines.japanese:
「そうだね…おめでとう。
それと、今年もよろしくね、母さん」
lines.english: “Yeah… congratulations. And here’s to another year, Mom.”

lines.japanese:
「うん、じゃ、ホテルでね。
挨拶済ませたらすぐに行くから」
lines.english: “I’ll see you at the hotel. I’ll come as soon as I’ve finished greeting everyone.”

lines.japanese: 「わかった、じゃ」
lines.english: “All right. Bye.”

lines.japanese:
「…辛気くさい鐘。
本当に日本なんだなぁ」
lines.english: “…What a dreary sound those bells make. I really am back in Japan.”

lines.japanese: 「なぁ…元気でやってるか？」
lines.english: “Hey… are you doing all right?”

lines.japanese:
「あけましておめでと。
今年もよろしくな」
lines.english: “Happy New Year. Here’s to another year.”

lines.japanese: 「………もう、会うこともないけど、な」
lines.english: “…Not that we'll ever see each other again.”

lines.japanese: 「あ…っ」
lines.english: “Ah!”

lines.japanese: 「…おめでとう、依緒」
lines.english: “…Happy New Year, Io.”

lines.japanese:
「あ、あ…ハッピーニューイヤー！
あけましておっめでと～！」
lines.english: “H-Happy New Year! Happy, happy New Year!”

lines.japanese: 「うん…今年もよろしくね」
lines.english: “Mm. Let's make it a good one.”

lines.japanese:
「よ、よかったぁぁぁ～、出てくれて！
すっごいドキドキしたんだよ～」
lines.english: “Oh, thank God you picked up! My heart was pounding!”

lines.japanese:
「ずいぶんテンション高いね…
飲んでる？」
lines.english: “You’re awfully excited. Have you been drinking?”

lines.japanese:
「あ～、確かにさっきまで飲んでたんだけどさぁ、
実はさっきまでずっと下がりっぱなしだったんだよね」
lines.english: “I was drinking until a little while ago, yeah. But the mood had been pretty grim all night.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ…今は外？」
lines.english: “I see. Are you outside now?”

lines.japanese:
「うん、これから二年参り。
雪菜は？」
lines.english: “Yeah. We're heading to the shrine now. What about you?”

lines.japanese:
「家だよ。
家族でおそば食べて、紅白見終わって、
今部屋に戻ってきたところ」
lines.english: “At home. We had soba, watched the Red and White Song Contest, and I just came back to my room.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか…」
lines.english: “Right…”

lines.japanese:
「ごめんね。
せっかく誘ってくれたのに」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. You went to all that trouble inviting me.”

lines.japanese:
「ま、仕方ないって。
小木曽家のしきたりはわかってるつもりだし」
lines.english: “It couldn't be helped. I know how the Ogiso family does things.”

lines.japanese: 「別に…そういうことじゃ…」
lines.english: “That wasn't really why…”

lines.japanese:
「それにまぁ…
あたしの方も、今から謝らなくちゃならないし」
lines.english: “Besides… I'm the one who has to apologize now.”

lines.japanese: 「どういう意味？」
lines.english: “What do you mean?”

lines.japanese:
「ごめん雪菜。
恨まれても仕方ないと思うけど…代わるね」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, Setsuna. You have every right to hate me for this, but… I'm handing the phone over.”

lines.japanese: 「依緒？」
lines.english: “Io?”

lines.japanese: 「雪菜…」
lines.english: “Setsuna…”

lines.japanese:
「切らないで！
もう少しだけ、俺と、話をしてくれよ…」
lines.english: “Don't hang up! Just… talk to me a little longer.”

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうして…？」
lines.english: “W-Why…?”

lines.japanese:
想像通り…いや、想像を遙かに超えて、
雪菜は、突然受話器から聞こえてきた俺の声に
うろたえていた。
lines.english: Just as I'd expected—no, far beyond anything I'd imagined—Setsuna panicked when my voice came through the phone without warning.

lines.japanese:
「俺が依緒に頼んだんだ。
俺からだと、出てくれないかもしれないって思って」
lines.english: “I asked Io to call. I thought you might not pick up if you saw my number.”

lines.japanese:
「そんな、ずるいよ…
ずるいよ、春希くん」
lines.english: “That's not fair… That's not fair, Haruki.”

lines.japanese: 「…ごめん」
lines.english: “…I’m sorry.”

lines.japanese:
「ううん、ずるいのはわたしだね…
酷いことしたのは、わたしの方だったよね」
lines.english: “No. I'm the unfair one. I'm the one who did something cruel.”

lines.japanese: 「雪菜…」
lines.english: “Setsuna…”

lines.japanese:
「こんな嫌な女にどうして声を聞かせてくれるの…？
おかしいよ、春希くん…」
lines.english: “Why would you speak to someone horrible like me again? It doesn't make sense, Haruki…”

lines.japanese: 「おかしい、かな？」
lines.english: “Doesn't it?”

lines.japanese:
「だって、だって…
わたし、あの時、わたしは…っ」
lines.english: “Because… because that night, I… I…”

lines.japanese: 雪菜の声が、少しずつ崩れていく。
lines.english: Little by little, Setsuna's voice came apart.

lines.japanese:
あからさまな動揺と、混乱と。
悲しみと戸惑いを織り交ぜて。
lines.english: Panic and confusion, sorrow and bewilderment—all of it audible in the fragments.

lines.japanese: なのに…ほんの少しだけ、弾んだ声。
lines.english: And yet… the faintest note of gladness.

lines.japanese: 「どうしても、謝りたかったから」
lines.english: “Because I had to tell you I was sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「どうして春希くんが謝るの…？」
lines.english: “Why are you apologizing to me?”

lines.japanese:
雪菜のそんな反応は、
俺の鼻の奥までつんとさせる。
lines.english: Her answer made my eyes sting.

lines.japanese:
「だって俺、雪菜の言う通り、嘘ついてたから。
かずさのこと、忘れてなかったから」
lines.english: “Because you were right. I lied to you. I never forgot Kazusa.”

lines.japanese:
きっと今の俺は、
今の雪菜と同じような顔をしてるんだと思う。
lines.english: I was sure my face looked much like hers.

lines.japanese:
「そして、これからも…
かずさのこと、ずっと忘れる訳がないって思うから」
lines.english: “And I know I'll never forget her. Not as long as I live.”
“Y-Yeah…”

lines.japanese: けれど、今は理性を保たなくちゃならない。
lines.english: But now I had to keep my head.

lines.japanese:
だって、ここから先は、絶対に譲れない。
言い負ける訳にはいかない。
lines.english: From here on, I couldn't give an inch. I had to win this argument.

lines.japanese:
「それから、それからさ…
これが一番謝らなくちゃならないことだと思うんだけど」
lines.english: “And then… there's one more thing. Probably the thing I need to apologize for most.”

lines.japanese: 『北原なら、できるよな？』
lines.english: ‘You can do that, can't you, Kitahara?’

lines.japanese: 誰かが勇気を与えてくれたから。
lines.english: Someone had given me courage.

lines.japanese:
『それでも、好きだから？
諦められないから？』
lines.english: ‘You still love her? You can't let her go?’

lines.japanese: 誰かが答えを教えてくれたから。
lines.english: Someone had taught me the answer.

lines.japanese:
『わたし、前向きな人ならＯＫです。
必死に頑張ってる人なら、嫌いになんかなりません』
lines.english: ‘I can accept anyone who's trying to move forward. I could never hate someone fighting with everything they have.’

lines.japanese:
誰かが…
正しい道を、指し示してくれたから。
lines.english: Someone had pointed me… in the right direction.

lines.japanese:
「それなのに俺…
やっぱり雪菜が大好きだから」
lines.english: “And after all of that… I still love you, Setsuna.”

lines.japanese: 「あ…ぅぁ」
lines.english: “A-Ah…”

lines.japanese:
「ごめんな…きっぱり振られたのに。
諦め、悪くって」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. You couldn't have been clearer when you turned me down, and I still can't give up.”

lines.japanese:
電話口からは、
声も息遣いも途絶えてしまっていた。
lines.english: No voice came through the phone. Not even the sound of breathing.

lines.japanese:
…何かが固いものにぶつかったような、
大きな音が響いた後から。
lines.english: Not since the crash—the sound of something striking a hard surface.

lines.japanese:
「じゃあ、おやすみ。
それと…あけましておめでとう」
lines.english: “Then… good night. And Happy New Year.”

lines.japanese:
だから、俺の言葉がどこまで雪菜に届いたのか、
今の俺にはわからない。
lines.english: I had no way of knowing how much of what I'd said had reached her.

lines.japanese:
「できれば…
今年も、よろしくな」
lines.english: “If you'll let me… let's make it a good one.”

lines.japanese: それでも構わない。
lines.english: That was all right.

lines.japanese: 今、決着をつけるべきは俺の心の問題だから。
lines.english: Tonight, the only thing I needed to settle was my own heart.

lines.japanese:
雪菜の気持ちの問題は、
雪菜がいる場所で解決しなくちゃならないから。
lines.english: Setsuna would have to work through her own feelings, wherever she was.

lines.japanese: 「ふ、ふぇ…っ」
lines.english: “H-Hh…”

lines.japanese:
「う、あ、ぁ…
ぁぁぁぁぁ…」
lines.english: “Ah… ahhh…”

lines.japanese:
「ぃぅっ…ぅ、ぅぅ…
ぁ、ぃぁ…は、春希…く…ぅぁ…っ」
lines.english: “Nn… ngh… H-Haruki…”

lines.japanese: 「ぃぇぇぁぁ…ぅ…く、う、う…」
lines.english: “Nnh… ngh… nn…”

lines.japanese: 「ありがと、依緒」
lines.english: “Thanks, Io.”

lines.japanese:
借りていた携帯を差し出しても、
依緒は受け取る様子もなく、
ただぼうっと俺の顔を眺めてる。
lines.english: I held out the borrowed phone. Io made no move to take it; she only stared at my face in a daze.

lines.japanese:
さっきまで、依緒と距離を置いていたはずの武也も、
そのすぐ隣に突っ立って、
やっぱりぼうっと俺の方を見てる。
lines.english: Takeya, who had kept his distance from Io until moments ago, now stood right beside her wearing the same vacant stare.

lines.japanese:
「さて、これからどうする？
予定通り二年参り行くか？
それとも、やっぱ解散？」
lines.english: “Well? What now? Shrine as planned, or are we calling it a night?”

lines.japanese:
「なんだよ？
俺の顔になにかついてるか？」
lines.english: “What? Is there something on my face?”

lines.japanese:
なんて…
こいつらが、こんな惚けた顔してる理由に
思い至らない訳なんかないけれど。
lines.english: As if I had no idea why they were staring at me like that.

lines.japanese:
そりゃ、確かに、
我ながら無茶したとは思ってるけれど。
lines.english: Even I had to admit I'd done something reckless.
“You…”
“…You…”

lines.japanese:
「あけましておめでとう、武也、依緒。
…お前らにだけ挨拶まだだったよな？」
lines.english: “Happy New Year, Takeya, Io. I hadn't said it to you two yet, had I?”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿ぁぁぁ～！」
lines.english: “You idiot!”

lines.japanese: 「てんめぇぇぇ～！」
lines.english: “You bastard!”

lines.japanese: 「うわぁっ！？」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese:
「このっ、このっ、このぉっ！
散々ヤキモキさせやがって～！」
lines.english: “You—you—you! You had us worried sick!”

lines.japanese:
「くせぇことしてんじゃねえよ！
お前、鳥肌立つかと思ったじゃねえか！」
lines.english: “Don't pull a stunt that sappy! You nearly gave me goosebumps!”

lines.japanese:
「こ、こら、こらっ！
はしゃぐな酔っぱらいども！」
lines.english: “H-Hey! Settle down, you drunks!”

lines.japanese:
依緒と武也、二人分の重みが頭にのしかかり、
姿勢も保てないまま、俺たちは歩道の真ん中で
右往左往する。
lines.english: Io and Takeya piled onto me from both sides. Unable to keep my balance, the three of us staggered all over the sidewalk.

lines.japanese:
周囲の人たちには、タチの悪い酔っぱらいの
大学生にしか見えないだろうけど。
いや、実際にその通りなんだけど。
lines.english: To anyone watching, we must have looked like a pack of obnoxious drunken college students. Which, to be fair, was exactly what we were.

lines.japanese:
「春希、春希…もう離すなよ！
二度と離すんじゃないぞ！」
lines.english: “Haruki—don't let her go again. Never let her go again!”

lines.japanese: 「とっくに振られてるけどな」
lines.english: “She's already dumped me.”

lines.japanese:
「くっそ、今日は朝まで付き合えよ？
ほんとお前、ホント勿体ぶりやがって！」
lines.english: “Damn it, you're staying out till morning. You really made us wait for that one!”

lines.japanese:
「解散じゃなかったのか？
ま、いいけどさ」
lines.english: “I thought we were calling it a night. Fine by me, though.”

lines.japanese:
それでも今は、
新年あけましておめでとうってことで、
多分、周囲の人たちも大目に見てくれるだろう。
lines.english: Still, it was New Year's. The people around us would probably let the spectacle pass.

lines.japanese:
…さっきまで喧嘩してたはずの俺たちの、
あまりに仲良しな光景にあてられつつも。
lines.english: Even if the sight of us suddenly this close—after fighting only moments ago—was a little much.

lines.japanese:
旧年中、お世話になった人たちに。
今年もお世話になるはずの人たちに。
lines.english: To everyone who had seen me through the year now past. To everyone who would see me through the year ahead.

lines.japanese:
頼もしく自分を支えてくれる人に。
頼んでもいないのに支えようとする人に。
嫌だと言っても支えられようとする人に。
lines.english: To the one who always had my back. To the one who tried to support me whether I asked or not. To the one who insisted on leaning on me however much I protested.

lines.japanese: 大切な友人たちに。
lines.english: To my dearest friends.

lines.japanese:
そして、いつも近くにいたのに、
ずっと、悲しませてばかりだった大切な人に…
lines.english: And to someone precious to me, who had always been close, and whom I had done nothing but hurt…

lines.japanese: あけまして、おめでとう。
lines.english: Happy New Year.

lines.japanese:
願わくは、今年“から”は
いい年でありますように。
lines.english: Please—let the good years start now.
